summary: Completion sentinels are existence-only, and generation, capture, and null partial work still cannot resume.
H2 Spearman still consumes calibrated gaps, while residual sensitivities bypass shared-row intersections.
Judge fallback remains single-cell, and P3 harvest omits the parsed rows it requires.
Odd-layer all-mode reruns and uploads primary raw and parsed artifacts.
G2 omits production-bundle equivalence and accepts stale commit or sentinel-selected tolerance values.
Fits and nulls can resolve independent main SHAs when no harvest revision is supplied.
